summary: Plug and Play is active and accepts startups into a global ecosystem; specific accelerator cohort dates vary by industry and location and are not published on the general programs page.

proposed_event.name: Plug and Play Tech Center
proposed_event.description: Global accelerator ecosystem connecting startups with corporate partners, pilots, resources, and investment opportunities.

dates.date_range_text: Rolling startup ecosystem intake; pilot-oriented accelerator program timing varies by vertical industry and location.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
sources.supports: States Plug and Play is an open innovation platform, organizes pilot-oriented acceleration programs, connects stage-agnostic startups with corporations, has no startup fees or equity requirement, may invest, and startups can apply by filling out a form.

sources.title: Venture Capital
sources.supports: States Plug and Play has accelerated over 10,000 startups, runs global programs for Seed to Series C companies, has 60+ locations and 550+ partners, and invests in startups case by case.

sources.title: Plug and Play | We Drive Innovation
sources.supports: Lists Plug and Play's global office locations and vertical industries, including Enterprise & AI, Fintech, Health, Energy, Crypto & Digital Assets, Mobility, and Sustainability.

sources.title: Accelerator Programs
sources.supports: Describes Plug and Play accelerator programs as identifying and supporting promising startups and enabling partners to access startups and events across many industries.

notes: No current universal application deadline, cohort start date, end date, or demo day was published for the general Plug and Play Tech Center program page.
The record is shaped as a rolling/global accelerator ecosystem rather than a dated cohort because Plug and Play runs many vertical and location-specific programs.
